title: Laravel API Toolkit
summary: Generate Postman-compatible API collections from Laravel routes.
description: A Composer library, judeufuoma/api-toolkit, with an Artisan command that reads API routes, controller documentation and FormRequest rules to generate a Postman collection.
contribution: Package development including collection generation, request examples from validation rules, route configuration, tests and a GitHub Actions workflow.

title: Domify Framework
summary: Exploring domain-driven application structure in a reusable PHP framework.
description: An experimental PHP framework project with a dependency container, middleware dispatcher, Eloquent integration, file caching and a database queue implementation.
contribution: Framework development exploring application structure, reusable infrastructure components and Composer-based dependency management.

title: Directcare Collaboration
summary: Contributing fixes and collaborating through merged pull requests.
description: A shared Nuxt/Vue frontend repository. Public pull-request history records contributions and merges by jude4, including pull request #7.
contribution: Collaborated on fixes and branch integration through pull requests. The linked contribution provides a public record of the work.
